data.title: Northern Discovery Metals Announces Marketing Program
data.description: Northern Discovery Metals Inc., based in Calgary, Alberta, has recently partnered with Nordcore Media LLC to utilize their digital marketing services. The company has agreed to engage Nordcore for an initial period of 30 days, starting on August 24, 2026, or until the budget is depleted. Nordcore Media LLC, located at 30 N Gould St Ste R Sheridan, WY 82801, can be reached via email at jrojas@nordcoremedia.net. The partnership allows for flexibility, with the potential for the marketing services period to be extended or shortened based on management's discretion. Northern Discovery Metals Inc. operates under the CSE ticker symbol NOR.

data.title: SolarMax Technology Receives Nasdaq Notice Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
data.description: SolarMax Technology, based in Riverside, California, and listed on Nasdaq under the symbol SMXT, recently received a notice from Nasdaq on August 20, 2026. The notice stated that the company is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to its failure to file the Form 10-Q for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. According to Nasdaq regulations, SolarMax has until October 19, 2026, to submit a plan to address this issue. If Nasdaq approves the plan, SolarMax may receive an extension of up to 180 days from the due date of the filing, extending the deadline to February 16, 2027.

data.title: Real and RE/MAX Holdings Announce Real’s Receipt of Court Approval of Proposed Arrangement in Connection with Proposed Combination
data.description: Real and RE/MAX Holdings have announced that Real has received court approval for the proposed arrangement related to their planned combination. This development signifies a significant milestone as they move forward with their collaboration. The approval underscores the progress made in finalizing the merger between the two entities. The court's decision paves the way for Real and RE/MAX Holdings to proceed with the integration process, which will now move forward following this important legal clearance.

data.title: loanDepot, Inc. Addresses Notice of NYSE Trading Price Non-Compliance
data.description: In Irvine, California, loanDepot, Inc. has announced that they are addressing a notice of non-compliance with the NYSE trading price requirements. The company's stock, traded under the symbol $LDI, failed to meet the minimum trading price set by the NYSE. This news comes amid concerns about the company's stock performance, with shares currently trading below the required threshold. LoanDepot, Inc. is actively working to rectify this situation to ensure compliance with NYSE regulations.

data.title: SOLOWIN HOLDINGS (NASDAQ: AXG) Celebrates 10‑Year Anniversary, Forging Compliance‑First Innovation for AI + Stablecoin Ecosystem
data.description: In Hong Kong on August 21, 2026, SOLOWIN HOLDINGS (Nasdaq: AXG), a prominent financial technology company merging traditional and digital assets, revealed its milestone of ten years in operation. The firm, also known as "AXG," and its subsidiaries commemorated this achievement by highlighting a decade of pioneering finance guided by compliance principles.

data.title: Columbus Circle Capital Corp II Announces Elroy Air Was Awarded an Up to $46M Contract with U.S. Army
data.description: Today, Columbus Circle Capital Corp II (Nasdaq: CMII), which will become Inflection Point Acquisition Corp VII (Nasdaq: IPXG), announced that Elroy Air secured a $46,058,871 contract to develop an autonomous hybrid-electric VTOL uncrewed aircraft system in California. The project is expected to be completed by 2029. The initial funding of $5,135,354 from the FY 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation, defense-wide budget has been allocated. The Army Contracting Command in Maryland is overseeing the contracting activities for this project (W911QX-26-C-A016).

data.title: Gray Announces Closing of Offering of $750 Million of 7.500% Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2034
data.description: In Atlanta on August 21, 2026, Gray Media, Inc. disclosed the successful completion of its recent offering. The offering comprised $750 million in total principal amount of 7.500% senior secured first lien notes due 2034, known as the "Notes," which were issued at par. Gray Media, Inc., traded on the NYSE under the symbol GTN, made this announcement.

data.title: Odysight.ai Inc. Announces Closing of $11 million Public Offering of Common Stock
data.description: In Ramat Gan, Israel on August 21, 2026, Odysight.ai Inc. revealed the completion of its recent public offering consisting of 3,437,500 shares of common stock. The Company, traded on Nasdaq/TASE under the symbol ODYS, anticipates gross earnings totaling $11 million from the offering, excluding underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated expenses. data.title: Jury Finds in Cytek’s Favor on Three of Four Asserted Claims; Company to Challenge Remaining Finding
data.description: Cytek Biosciences, based in Fremont, California, and listed on Nasdaq as CTKB, recently won a patent infringement case against Beckman Coulter, Inc. in the United States District Court for the District of Delaware. The jury ruled in favor of Cytek on three out of the four patent claims, citing noninfringement and invalidity on those three claims. However, one claim was found to be infringed under the doctrine of equivalents, leading to a verdict of $20 million in lost profits and $36 million in royalties. Cytek plans to challenge the infringement finding and the damages awarded through post-verdict motions.

data.title: Head of Bitget predicts Bitcoin to hover around current levels by year-end, doubts US will invest in BTC.
data.description: According to Gracy Chen, Bitcoin may remain within the range of $10,000 to $20,000 due to macroeconomic uncertainty. It is also unlikely that the US government will purchase Bitcoin in the next two years.
